corte-rachel: A shoulder-length, heavily layered 1990s cut: the perimeter rests right at the tops of the shoulders, with short, rounded layers starting at the cheekbones and chunky, choppy front pieces framing the chin and jawline. The crown is cut shorter for lifted, rounded volume. Side part. Styled with a round-brush blowout: smooth, bouncy and full, with the layered ends flicked in alternating directions, some curving outward and some turning under, so the shape looks airy and piecey. Glossy, swingy, polished finish with clearly visible, separated layers.
corte-hime: A Japanese hime cut: long, sleek, one-length hair falling to mid-back with a blunt perimeter and no layers. A dense, perfectly straight fringe is cut straight across at eyebrow level. On each side, the front sections (sidelocks) are cut bluntly in a crisp horizontal line between the cheekbones and the chin, falling straight down beside the cheeks like two vertical panels, clearly shorter than and disconnected from the long lengths behind them. Pin-straight, smooth, glossy styling, the part hidden under the fringe, every edge crisp and precise.
ondas-gisele: A long layered cut falling to mid-back, with long, soft layers starting at the chin and longer front pieces starting at the cheekbones. Styled in big, loose, glamorous beach waves: wide, soft S-shaped bends that begin around ear level and roll through to the ends, alternating direction section by section and brushed slightly apart for an undone, windswept feel. Deep side part with generous root lift, lots of airy volume and movement, softly tousled ends. Natural, beachy texture with a satin sheen and realistic, separated strands.
coque-clean-girl: A sleek, slicked-back low bun: all the hair is brushed tightly and smoothly back from the hairline with a precise center part, lying flat and glossy against the head, with no volume at the crown, no loose strands and no fringe. The lengths are gathered at the nape and wrapped into a neat, compact, round bun sitting low at the back of the head. Polished, ultra-smooth, gel-like finish with fine comb lines faintly visible and tidy edges at the temples and around the ears.
ondas-hollywood: A 1940s Hollywood glamour wave style on hair falling just past the shoulders, with long, subtle layers. A deep side part, with the front section swept from the part across the upper forehead in one smooth, sculpted wave and down along the side of the head. All the lengths are set in large, uniform, glossy S-waves that run in continuous, aligned ridges from the crown to the ends, brushed into one smooth, defined, cascading shape with soft volume. Ends turned under in polished curls. Mirror-like shine, sculpted, refined vintage finish.
corte-farrah: A 1970s feathered cut with big, bouncy volume, falling just past the shoulders, with many long, tapered, feathered layers starting at the cheekbones. Long curtain bangs part in the center and are curled back and away in large, wing-like rolls on both sides, blending into the feathered sides, which are also flipped back in soft tiers. High lift at the crown, and the lengths roll outward and backward in voluminous, flicked-out curls. Big, airy, brushed-out, glossy 70s blow-dry with soft, separated, feather-like strands.
permanente-anos-80: A big 1980s perm: layered hair falling just past the shoulders, permed from root to ends into springy spiral curls about 1.5 to 2 cm in diameter, uniform all over the head. Huge, teased-out volume at the crown and sides that widens toward the ends into a full, rounded, triangular silhouette. Side part, with the front curls pushed up and back off the forehead with lift. Bouncy, crisp, voluminous curls with clearly defined individual ringlets and a soft, natural sheen.
pin-up-franja-bettie: A 1950s pin-up cut with Bettie bangs: the hair falls to just above the shoulders with long, soft layers. A very short, dense, blunt fringe is cut high on the forehead, about halfway between the hairline and the eyebrows, shaped in a rounded U-curve that is shortest in the center and curves slightly lower toward the temples. The lengths are set in smooth, glossy vintage curls that roll under at the ends all around, with a sculpted, rounded silhouette and soft volume at the crown. Polished, defined retro finish.
estilo-wandinha: A gothic two-braid style: a very short, blunt, dense fringe cut straight across high on the forehead, well above the eyebrows. Behind it, a sharp, perfectly straight center part runs from the fringe to the nape, dividing the hair into two equal halves. Each half is plaited into a tight, neat, classic three-strand braid that starts just behind the ear and hangs down in front of the shoulder, ending at mid-chest with a short natural tail. Sleek, flat, smooth crown; real hair braids with even, tidy plaits and no flyaways.
rabo-de-cavalo-alto: A sleek high ponytail: all the hair is brushed smoothly and tightly up from the hairline, temples and nape, with no part, no fringe and no loose pieces, and gathered high at the crown. The ponytail is long, straight and full, falling from the crown down past the shoulder blades in a sleek, glossy, swinging length with slightly curved ends. The base is wrapped with a strand of its own hair so no tie shows. Smooth, tight, polished, high-shine finish with a slight lift at the crown.
camadas-s-curl-coreanas: A Korean S-curl layered cut falling just below the collarbones: soft, seamless layers start at the cheekbones, with longer front pieces at the jawline. A thin, sheer, see-through air fringe falls lightly to the eyebrows, with the forehead visible through it. From ear level down, the hair is styled in soft, loose, elegant S-shaped waves, like a gentle Korean build perm, each layer curving outward and then back inward. Airy volume at the crown; light, bouncy, silky, polished finish with glossy, separated strands.
hippie-perm-coreano: A Korean hippie perm: layered hair falling just past the shoulders, permed from close to the roots down to the ends into small, soft, irregular S-shaped waves about 1 cm wide, giving a fluffy, airy, rippled texture throughout. A wispy, see-through fringe with the same small waves falls to the eyebrows. Full, rounded volume that widens softly toward the ends, center part. Soft, satin-matte, slightly fuzzy, bohemian finish with very fine, separated, natural-looking wavy strands.
corte-meg-ryan: A choppy 1990s shag falling between the chin and the jawline, cut with lots of short, razored, disconnected layers throughout so the whole shape is piecey and messy. The crown has tousled lift, and the sides are cut into feathered, separated pieces that flick out in different directions. Short, uneven, piecey bangs are pushed to one side across the forehead. Styled deliberately undone and bedhead-like with texturizing product: chunky, separated pieces and an airy, lived-in, playful finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
cachos-marilyn: A 1950s glamour curl set on a short cut falling between the chin and the jawline, with short, rounded layers. Deep side part, with the front swept up and over into one big, soft, voluminous curl. The rest of the hair is set in large, bouncy, brushed-out pin curls that roll up and away from the head all around, forming a full, rounded cloud of soft, glossy curls. Lots of volume at the sides and crown; sculpted yet soft vintage Hollywood finish with defined curl shapes and a soft sheen.
bob-amelie: A French bob in the Amélie style: a rounded, one-length bob falling to the jawline, the ends softly curving inward so the sides hug the cheeks and jaw. A very short, slightly choppy fringe sits at mid-forehead, well above the eyebrows, cut fairly straight with softly irregular tips. Smooth, gently full, rounded silhouette with a slight bevel at the ends and no visible part behind the fringe. Neat but soft, natural finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
bob-louise-brooks: A 1920s flapper bob in the Louise Brooks style: a short, sleek, helmet-like bob with a dense, blunt fringe cut straight across just above the eyebrows. The sides fall straight down over the ears and are cut in a smooth curve that sweeps forward into two sharp points on the cheeks at earlobe level. The back is shingled short and tapered close to the nape. Ultra-smooth, glossy, perfectly aligned strands, crisp precise lines and a sculpted, polished silhouette.
finger-waves-anos-20: A 1920s finger-wave bob: a chin-length, one-length bob with a deep side part. All the hair is set close to the head in sculpted finger waves: deep, glossy, S-shaped ridges that run in parallel rows from the part across the top and down the sides to the ends, alternating direction, with crisp, evenly spaced crests and troughs. The ends finish in flat, sculpted pin curls along the jawline. Lacquered, high-shine, perfectly smooth, defined vintage finish with no frizz.
victory-rolls: A 1940s victory rolls hairstyle on shoulder-length hair: a deep side part, with the front hair on each side of the part rolled back into two large, smooth, symmetrical barrel rolls that sit high on top of the head, curving up and away from the forehead. The back and lower lengths are left down, set in glossy, smooth curls that roll under at the shoulders. Sleek, sculpted sides; polished, defined vintage pin-up finish with smooth roll surfaces and no flyaways.
colmeia-beehive: A 1960s beehive updo: the hair is heavily backcombed at the crown and smoothed over into a tall, rounded, dome-shaped mound that rises high above the top of the head. The front is swept straight back from the hairline with a smooth, glossy surface, and the sides are brushed up and tucked into the dome, leaving the ears visible. The lengths are wrapped and pinned invisibly at the back. Big, sculpted, sleek, voluminous vintage finish with a polished surface and realistic, soft strand detail.
bufante-anos-60: A 1960s bouffant flip: hair falling between the chin and the shoulders, teased at the crown into a high, rounded dome of volume with the surface brushed sleek and polished. Soft side part, with the front swept back from the forehead. The sides fall smooth and full, and the ends all around curl up and outward in one crisp, uniform flip at neck level. Glossy, lacquered, structured vintage finish with a rounded, bell-shaped silhouette.
corte-pajem: A pageboy cut: a smooth, rounded bob falling between the jawline and the base of the neck, one length, with the ends rolled under all around in one continuous, smooth inward curve. A full, rounded fringe is brushed down and curves softly under at eyebrow length, blending into the sides. Natural lift at the crown, sides falling smooth and full over the ears, rounded bell-shaped silhouette. Polished, glossy round-brush finish with neat, aligned strands.
wedge-anos-70: A 1970s wedge cut in the Dorothy Hamill style: a short, rounded, bouncy cut with the sides at mid-ear level, swept slightly back so the earlobes show. At the back, the hair is cut in stacked, graduated layers that build a full, rounded wedge of volume above the occipital bone and taper close into a short nape. A soft, wispy, full fringe falls to just above the eyebrows. Rounded, swingy, mushroom-like silhouette with feathered, blended layers and a light, bouncy finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
frisado-crimped: A crimped hairstyle on long, lightly layered hair falling past the shoulder blades: every section is crimped from the roots to the ends into tight, uniform, angular zigzag ridges about 0.5 to 1 cm apart, giving a fine, regular, ribbed texture. The crimping creates big, wide, airy volume that expands toward the ends into a full, rounded triangular shape. Center part, brushed out lightly so the zigzag pattern stays clearly visible. Satin-matte, textured, retro 80s and Y2K finish with realistic, detailed strands.
franja-armada-anos-80: A 1980s big-hair style on layered hair falling just past the shoulders: a tall fringe is backcombed and sprayed into a high, stiff, curved wall that rises above the forehead and fans forward into a curl, with the front side pieces feathered back. The lengths are layered and teased for huge volume, set with curling-iron waves and brushed out into a wide, full, fluffy mane. Lots of height at the crown and width at the sides. Voluminous, hairsprayed, textured, glamorous retro finish.
space-buns-meio-preso: A half-up space buns style: a neat center part divides the top section of the hair, and each half is gathered and twisted into a small, round, compact bun sitting high on each side of the crown. The rest of the hair is left down, falling loose past the shoulders with soft movement. A few thin, wispy strands are left out at the temples. Playful, neat yet slightly undone finish with smoothly wrapped buns. Keep the natural hair texture.
